concepts.gloss_en: meriting the renewal of the world that is to come (the future/eschatological renewal)
meriting the renewal of the world (unqualified renewal of the world)

members.note: representative; lacks the qualifier שלעתיד, so referent may be broader than the specifically future renewal

notes: Both appear in lm2:8 and share the phrase חדוש העולם, but one adds the qualifier שלעתיד ('of the future'), which narrows the object of the meriting to the eschatological renewal. Different construct/qualified objects are different concepts (rule 4); under-merge preferred. If the human confirms the unqualified form always refers to the same future renewal in these usages, they could be merged as likely.
